headline: Veeam App v2.0.0 lands; GitHub Feed CIDR truncation and XDR Collector _time parsing fixed
summary_md:
- **Veeam** shipped a v2.0.0 app, 15,708 insertions against 2,302 deletions — larger than the other seven packs of the day combined.
- Two ingestion-correctness fixes worth acting on: **FeedGitHub** was truncating CIDR prefix lengths, and **LinuxEventsCollection** was setting `_time` wrongly for XDR Collector logs.
- **CyberArkEPM** moved to a version-less EPM API and fixed set names containing commas.
- The rest is fetch reliability and parsing repair in **CybleEventsV2**, **MailListener** and **HealthCheck**.

highlights.title: Veeam App v2.0.0
highlights.detail: A major-version release and by far the day's largest change at 15,708 insertions and 2,302 deletions.

highlights.title: GitHub Feed was truncating CIDR prefix lengths
highlights.detail: A feed emitting truncated CIDRs produces indicators covering the wrong address range, so any ranges ingested before this fix are suspect.

highlights.title: XDR Collector logs had the wrong _time, with a collection-time fallback added
highlights.detail: Event timestamps for Linux collection are corrected and now fall back to collection time when the log's own timestamp cannot be parsed.

highlights.title: CyberArk EPM switched to the version-less EPM API
highlights.detail: The integration no longer pins an EPM API version, and set names containing commas are parsed correctly.

items.Packs/Veeam: Veeam App v2.0.0, a major-version release of 15,708 insertions and 2,302 deletions.
items.Packs/CyberArkEPM: Uses the version-less EPM API and fixes handling of set names that contain commas (XSUP-74944).
items.Packs/CybleEventsV2: Fetch reliability and incident submission reworked, 652 insertions against 151 deletions.
items.Packs/HealthCheck: Updated for both v6 and v8, rewriting roughly as much as it adds (646 insertions, 543 deletions).
items.Packs/MailListener: Fixes a date parsing issue in Mail Listener v2 (XSUP-76251).
items.Packs/FeedGitHub: Fixes truncated CIDR prefix lengths in the emitted feed indicators.
items.Packs/DuoAdminApi: A small pydantic bug fix, 22 insertions against 19 deletions.
items.Packs/LinuxEventsCollection: Fixes _time for XDR Collector logs and adds a collection-time fallback (XSUP-74923).
